ops.description: The ordered list of edit ops to apply.

id.description: Target item id (move/resize/split/replace/remove/speed/flip/volume/mute/disable), or the new track's id (addTrack — must not collide; omit for an auto id).

speed.description: Playback rate 0.1..10 (for speed) — 2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed, 1 = normal.

flipH.description: Mirror left/right (for flip). Omit to leave the horizontal axis unchanged.

flipV.description: Mirror top/bottom (for flip). Omit to leave the vertical axis unchanged.

track.description: Target track id — 'video'/'music' on a cut, 'picture'/'dialogue' on an animatic (reorder/repack; on move it re-homes the item onto that same-type track).

trackId.description: Track to insert into (for insert) — the lane's id, e.g. 'video' or 'music'.

id.description: Unique id for the new item — must not already exist on the timeline (every other op targets items by id).

src.description: Media URL, e.g. a pool item's `src` ('/gen/<file>' or '/sound-media/<file>'). Omit (or null) only for a slate.

sourceDurationInFrames.description: The media's full natural length in frames. Set it for video/audio (a clip can be trimmed shorter but never stretched past it); leave it off for images.

offsetFrames.description: Source in-point — frames skipped at the head of the media (default 0).

speed.description: Playback rate (default 1). The clip plays durationInFrames × speed source frames, so set durationInFrames to the RETIMED length, not the media's own.

kind.description: 'image' for a still held on screen (no source timeline); omit for ordinary video/audio media.

bundle.description: Which shot bundle this clip came from, e.g. 'MS-05'.

shot.description: Which shot's picture slot this is (image items).

stillFile.description: Which still take is showing (image items).

src.description: New media URL (for replace), e.g. the `url` attach_still returned.

stillFile.description: The still take's `file` (for replace) — records which take is on screen.

name.description: New label — for `replace` the clip's label, for `addTrack` the track's, for `rename` the PROJECT's name.

at.description: Absolute timeline frame to cut at (for split) — strictly inside the clip.

disabled.description: Disable flag (for disable) — true greys out the clip and skips it in playback.
